mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `exam_record` WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} AND student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: r.*, p.paper_name, p.total_score, c.course_name, u.real_name AS student_name, u.username
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `exam_record` r INNER JOIN `paper` p ON r.paper_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `course` c ON p.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.student_id = u.id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.submit_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `exam_record` (paper_id, student_id, student_answer, score, status) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{studentId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{score}, #{status})
